title: Retrieval Augmented Enhanced Dual Co-Attention Framework for Target Aware Multimodal Bengali Hateful Meme Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and performance evaluation of a multimodal framework for hate speech classification. While 'Religious' and 'Religious groups' are used as target categories for the classification task, the paper does not evaluate religious doctrines, moral philosophies, or ethical systems themselves, but rather the model's ability to identify hateful content directed at those entities.
